farfetchd-acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
farfetchd-acrobatics.description: Bond skill: flits up to 2 hexes into a foe (Power 60) and engages it.

farfetchd-air-slash.name: Air Slash
farfetchd-air-slash.description: Bond skill: a blade of air at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 85).

farfetchd-defiant.name: Defiant
farfetchd-defiant.description: Deals 20% more damage while 2+ foes stand next to it.

farfetchd-keen-eye.name: Keen Eye
farfetchd-keen-eye.description: Its ranged moves fire over Pokémon standing in the way.

farfetchd-swords-dance.name: Swords Dance
farfetchd-swords-dance.description: New skill: a frenetic leek dance makes it Focused for 2 turns.

farfetchd-air-cutter.name: Air Cutter
farfetchd-air-cutter.description: New skill: razor-like wind at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 55).

farfetchd-leek-guard.name: Leek Parry
farfetchd-leek-guard.description: Takes 10% less damage: it parries with its leek.

farfetchd-fury-cutter.name: Fury Cutter
farfetchd-fury-cutter.description: Each consecutive hit on the same foe deals 10% more, up to 3 stacks.

farfetchd-night-slash.name: Night Slash
farfetchd-night-slash.description: New skill: a swift slash at an opening (Power 70) that Exposes the foe for 1 turn.

farfetchd-stick-fighter.name: Stick Fighter
farfetchd-stick-fighter.description: Deals 15% more damage to adjacent foes.

farfetchd-tailwind.name: Swift Wings
farfetchd-tailwind.description: Regains 2 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn.

farfetchd-brave-bird.name: Brave Bird
farfetchd-brave-bird.description: New skill: a reckless diving charge (Power 100).

farfetchd-hurricane.name: Hurricane
farfetchd-hurricane.description: New skill: a howling gale up to 1 hex away (Power 90) hitting a 1-hex area.

farfetchd-inner-focus.name: Inner Focus
farfetchd-inner-focus.description: Cannot be put to Sleep or Paralyzed.

farfetchd-duelist.name: Duelist
farfetchd-duelist.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes at full HP.

farfetchd-sky-attack.name: Sky Attack
farfetchd-sky-attack.description: New skill: dives from above at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 100).

farfetchd-leek-combo.name: Leek Flurry
farfetchd-leek-combo.description: A knockout on its turn lets it use its basic attack again.

farfetchd-flock-call.name: Wild Duck Spirit
farfetchd-flock-call.description: Gives the team 1 Bond when it lands a combo.

farfetchd-leek-master.name: Leek Master
farfetchd-leek-master.description: Capstone. A knockout resets its skill cooldowns; deals 20% more below half HP.

farfetchd-sky-sovereign.name: Super Luck
farfetchd-sky-sovereign.description: Capstone. Deals 20% more damage to Exposed foes; its Flying moves deal 15% more damage.

farfetchd-double-edge.name: Double-Edge
farfetchd-double-edge.description: Bond skill: a reckless leek-first charge (Power 95, Attack).

farfetchd-razor-wind.name: Razor Wind
farfetchd-razor-wind.description: New skill: beats its wings into blades of wind at every adjacent foe (Power 85).

farfetchd-leer.name: Leer
farfetchd-leer.description: New skill: a sharp glare that Marks adjacent foes for 2 turns.
